draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Manipal! Locals call it Campus Town, since more than twenty-five thousand students come here every year to study at the Manipal Academy of Higher Education.
draft.hungryLine: You're next door to Udupi, home of the famous vegetarian cuisine cooked without onion or garlic, with subtle flavours.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Manipal Institute of Technology is a 10 minute walk, and the Sri Krishna Temple in Udupi is about 5 km away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Manipal End-point Park is a small cliff over the Suwarna river, with views of the sea and the mountains.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Manipal's dental college, set up in 1965, was India's first private dental college.

spots.name: Manipal End-point Park
spots.detail: In Manipal · Cliff views of the Suwarna river, sea and hills

spots.name: Manipal Institute of Technology
spots.detail: 10 min walk · The campus that started as Manipal Engineering College

spots.name: Sri Krishna Temple and Mutt
spots.detail: In Udupi, about 5 km away · Free lunch for everyone

legends.title: Kanaka's Window
legends.body: The Krishna statue faces west, away from devotees. It's said that when Kanakadasa was denied entry, he prayed at a small window outside and the Lord turned around to face him.

tips.title: Eat lunch at the Krishna Temple.
tips.body: The temple in Udupi serves free lunch to everyone in its three dining halls.

tips.title: Plan for the monsoon.
tips.body: Manipal gets moderate to heavy rain in the monsoon, which keeps it green all year.

story.title: An engineering college
story.body: Manipal Engineering College opened in 1957. Today it's the Manipal Institute of Technology.

story.title: A first for India
story.body: Manipal College of Dental Sciences opened as India's first private dental college.

story.title: Formula Manipal races
story.body: The student car team, started as an idea in 2007, made its debut at FSAE Italy in 2008.

story.title: Institute of Eminence
story.body: The Government of India gave Manipal Academy of Higher Education the status of Institute of Eminence.
